Update only the existing branch f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; its head must be 96683e2502e4d25f665ff77afb52acb292c2ac78 (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Parts A-C are MERGED on main as PR #812 (211e999) with later review fixes you must keep (build-start proof requires a chunk committed by this launch; an unproven worker is stopped; a running worker is verified by its source/identity/generation labels before any receipt is written; the operator-code manifest now also lists sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt and migrations 001/003/004/006/011). Do not touch codex/run-38443286322-1 (superseded). read git log --stat origin/main..HEAD and then the files you depend on: scripts/operator/lib/f2d_operator_identity.{sh,py} (identity FIRST in every action; F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED), scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py (seal/load_sealed/canonical_sha256), scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py (run_plan_probe(connection, statements_document, ...) -- the entry point you call inside the publication transaction) and scripts/v3_plan_probe_statements.py (generated inside the API container), scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh (how the statements are generated through docker exec -i and how the dense anchor and image digest are resolved -- reuse those shell functions by copying them; the one-way published_at; advisory lock 764003001), scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py (acquire_lock at <receipt_directory>/deploy.lock with fcntl LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, external_authority paths in deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json: receipt_directory /var/lib/ed-finder/v3-production/receipts, api_env_file /etc/ed-finder/v3-production/api.env mode 0600 root; the active loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:58080; exact_host_guard; smoke()), .github/workflows/v3-production-application-deploy.yml (the protected workflow: concurrency group v3-production-application-authority, the authority-gate step, the approval-gated protected job, the V3_PRODUCTION_* SSH credential boundary, how a source-free bundle is shipped and executed with sudo), apps/api/src/routers/archetypes.py lines 630-680 (GET /api/archetypes/rankings: offset/limit bounds, offset + limit <= 10000) and apps/api/src/routers/search.py line 157 + apps/api/src/models.py lines 540-560 (POST /api/local/search: from/size in the JSON body), and deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json accepted_release_schema_compatibility (today: source_sha, release_run_id, manifest_sha256, images.backend/web, compatible_migration_sets, evidence; part D2b adds ranking_version, ranking_sha256, f2d_operator_code_sha256 -- this part reads those three fields and REFUSES when they are absent, so the action cannot run before D2b's attestation exists). Part D2b follows; leave the branch in a state it can continue from. No pull request until D2b has landed.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md. Read CLAUDE.md first, then design section 8.6 IN FULL, 8.7 (the probe runs pre-commit on the publisher's own connection where it can see its newly visible rows), 8.3 (identities), 8.8, section 8 "Order" paragraph (publication is what makes the Finder live; the pointer does not move), section 7.2 (publication state and audit), and the PR4 bullet in section 10. Where this task and the design differ, the design wins; where the design and the current code differ, follow the design and name the conflict in your summary. Code only: no deployment, no production access, no production credentials. The action is not run in this PR.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh (new; named in the manifest comment block -- move it into the active sorted list); scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py (new; the in-container transaction program); deploy/v3-production/f2d-operator-code.txt (add both; keep sorted; extend EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES in tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py); .github/workflows/v3-production-application-deploy.yml (a new operation publish-finder-products as described below; the existing inventory/preflight/promote paths stay byte-for-byte unchanged except for the choice list and the case statements that route the new operation); tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py (new), tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py (new: action + workflow contract), tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py (EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES only), tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py or whichever test asserts the protected workflow's operations/steps (extend, never weaken), tests/test_python314_execution_surfaces.py only if required; CHANGES.md. Any other changed path must be justified in your summary as required by a specific failing test, otherwise it is a failure. Do not modify the plan probe, the build actions, the gate, the identity helpers, or scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py (its lock file path is reused, its code is not changed).

ACTION (scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh run <REPO_ROOT> <SOURCE_SHA> <ACTOR>). Identity FIRST (F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED); require_target with the pinned constants (hostname ed-finder-prod, FQDN nb79a3d.mevnode.com, postgres container, database, compose project, worker network, TARGET_GENERATION_KEY/ID/sequence as the other F2d actions); require_stage (/var/tmp/edfinder-v3-publish-<sha>, marker .v3-publish-source-sha, wheelhouse .v3-probe-wheelhouse); ACTOR must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._@:/-]{1,128}$ (the workflow passes "github:<actor>/run-<run_id>"); require_generation (key, UUID, sequence 1, current, PUBLISHED). Then ACQUIRE THE HOST DEPLOYMENT LOCK: flock -n on /var/lib/ed-finder/v3-production/receipts/deploy.lock (the path the deploy script uses; read it from deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json external_authority.receipt_directory in the staged checkout with python3.14 rather than hard-coding, and refuse unless it equals /var/lib/ed-finder/v3-production/receipts), refusing with exit 70 when a deployment holds it; hold it on an inherited descriptor until the action exits. With the lock held, in this order with DISTINCT exit codes and a sealed failure receipt naming the item: (1) exit 71: both Finder products on the pinned generation are READY with validation_receipt status VERIFIED and published_at IS NULL (db_query; already-published refuses with exit 72 and a receipt saying publication already happened -- never a second publication); (2) exit 73: the active API container's image digest (docker inspect {{.Image}} and RepoDigests) equals accepted_release_schema_compatibility.images.backend in the staged target-authority.json, AND that block carries ranking_version (non-empty), ranking_sha256 (64 hex) and f2d_operator_code_sha256 equal to the attested identity -- absent fields refuse (D2b adds them); (3) exit 74: the behavioural probe pairs of design 8.1 against http://127.0.0.1:58080 with python3.14 urllib (no curl): GET /api/archetypes/rankings?archetype=paradise&offset=9999&limit=1 -> 503 and ...&offset=9999&limit=2 -> 422; POST /api/local/search with JSON {"galaxy_wide":true,"sort_by":"development","from":9999,"size":1} -> 503 and with "size":2 -> 422 (read the router to confirm the exact bodies the route accepts and adjust; the point is: validation 422 fires before the 503 not-ready gate); record every status; (4) exit 75: the Search product manifest's code identity and the Archetype manifest's code_sha256 and model_file_sha256 (read from v3_meta.derived_product.manifest for both products) equal the checkout's (compute via scripts/v3_system_search.py product_manifest / scripts/v3_system_archetype.code_identity() inside the worker container) and the Archetype model_file_sha256 equals sha256 of /app/shared_contracts/v3_system_archetype_model.py in the running API image (docker exec the active API container: sha256sum of that file); (5) exit 76: both build-final receipts load sealed, name this generation and these manifests, and their last_vacuum and last_analyze postdate their final_insert_at (also re-read pg_stat_user_tables now and require the live values to be >= the receipts' values); (6) generate the plan-probe statements exactly as v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh does (docker exec -i of scripts/v3_plan_probe_statements.py inside the ACTIVE API container with the densest anchor resolved from v3_spatial.cell_summary), record their sha256; (7) run the transaction program in a worker container (API image, /work read-only, wheelhouse psycopg, DSN through a mode-0600 env file from the active API's DATABASE_URL exactly as the build actions do, NOT read-only -- this is the one F2d action that writes; --read-only root filesystem with --tmpfs /tmp is still used; the run directory mounted read-write at /publish for the handshake files and the receipt; bounded --cpus 2 --memory 4g; timeout 1800 s). THE COMMIT HANDSHAKE realizes "its last statement before COMMIT repeats the image-digest check" with the host as the digest authority: the program, after the plan probe passes, writes /publish/ready-to-commit.json {generation, products, published_at values, plan_probe_receipt_sha256} and then polls (every second, at most 120 s) for /publish/commit-decision.json; the host action, still holding the deployment lock, waits for ready-to-commit.json, re-inspects the active API container's image digest, compares it with the attestation again, and writes commit-decision.json {"decision":"commit"} or {"decision":"abort","reason":...} with mode 0600 via a temp file + rename; the program COMMITs only on "commit" and ROLLS BACK on abort, timeout or any malformed decision; exit 77 for a host-side abort, 78 for the handshake timeout. (8) After the container exits 0 the host verifies through db_query that both published_at are now non-NULL and equal to the audit rows, writes the sealed action receipt (schema_version ed-finder/v3-publish-derived-products/v1: generation identity; actor; image digest checked twice with both readings; attestation fields; probe-pair statuses; manifest identities; vacuum/analyze readings; statements sha256; the plan-probe receipt's content_sha256 and status; published_at for both products; the audit rows; bounded view visibility evidence; f2d_operator_code_sha256; publication_performed true; db_writes_performed true) to the run directory and prints the operation-result envelope (operation v3-publish-derived-products, status published|refused|failed, exit_code, failures, read_only false, db_writes_performed <true only after COMMIT>, publication_performed <same>, canonical_writes_performed false, application_service_changes_performed false). Any refusal before step 7 performs no write and the envelope says so.

PROGRAM (scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py). Identity first (require_operator_code_identity) and refuse_unlisted_checkout_modules (copy from the complete read). psycopg connection with autocommit=False; one transaction: SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '600s'; SELECT ... FROM v3_meta.derived_product ... FOR UPDATE on the two product rows (verify READY/VERIFIED/unpublished again inside the transaction); SELECT v3_meta.publish_derived_product(%s,'system_search',%s); SELECT v3_meta.publish_derived_product(%s,'system_archetype',%s) (the order Search then Archetype as the fixture seeds do); verify both published_at are equal to transaction_timestamp() and the two audit rows exist; verify view visibility on this connection with BOUNDED statements only -- one sentinel count per v3_app view (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM v3_app.system_search LIMIT 10001) t, same for system_archetype and system_archetype_summary, each required to be 10001 for the full generation) plus pg_class.reltuples of both physical tables -- never a full count(*) over 198.5 M rows inside the publication transaction (name this disposition: the design says "view counts", a bounded sentinel is what the Finder itself uses); then run_plan_probe(connection, statements_document, generation_id=..., search_final_insert_at=..., archetype_final_insert_at=..., dense_anchor_cell=..., allow_unpublished=True -- the rows are visible to this transaction only) with SET LOCAL for plan_cache_mode/statement_timeout; on a failed probe receipt ROLLBACK and exit 22; then the commit handshake above; COMMIT; write the sealed program receipt to /publish/receipt.json (including the probe receipt) and print it. Exit codes: 0 published; 2 identity; 22 plan probe failed (rolled back); 71-78 as above where the program can detect them (re-checks of product state are 71/72); 4 database error (rolled back). Parameterized SQL only; actor passed as a parameter; no string-built identifiers.

WORKFLOW (.github/workflows/v3-production-application-deploy.yml). Add operation publish-finder-products to the choice list. It runs in the same approval-gated protected job as promote, under the existing concurrency group v3-production-application-authority (cancel-in-progress false), after the authority-gate step (python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate must still pass -- the publication is a production mutation under the same authority), and it does NOT need a release run ID (skip the candidate manifest download/authentication steps for this operation; the attestation in deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json is the identity source). Steps for this operation: stage trusted main under /var/tmp/edfinder-v3-publish-<sha> with marker .v3-publish-source-sha and the .v3-probe-wheelhouse (copy the ops workflow's stage pattern but with the V3_PRODUCTION_* SSH credential boundary of this workflow and its pinned known_hosts); read F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED from deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json accepted_release_schema_compatibility.f2d_operator_code_sha256 of the checked-out main (fail closed if absent or not 64 hex); run the action as root-or-sudo with F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED exported and ACTOR "github:${{ github.actor }}/run-${{ github.run_id }}", tee the envelope to a receipt, upload it as artifact v3-publish-derived-products-operation (retention 90). Never print the DSN; never pass secrets on command lines.

TESTS. tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py on the disposable fixtures (PostgreSQL 18 in CI; runners have no PostgreSQL -- write them, run what runs, list the rest): with a fixture generation holding both products READY/VERIFIED/unpublished and a fake statements document plus a stubbed run_plan_probe: a passing probe + "commit" decision publishes both, published_at equal, audit rows present, views visible afterwards; a failing probe rolls back (published_at still NULL, no audit rows); an "abort" decision rolls back; a handshake timeout rolls back (use a 1-second timeout override); products READY but one already published -> 72 without writes; the out-of-order case of design 8.6 (products READY, old image digest) is refused by the ACTION before the container (shell test with a fake docker in PATH, or assert the ordering in the source); vacuum predating the final insert -> 76; identity mismatch -> 75; and the program source contains no DELETE/TRUNCATE/UPDATE other than through publish_derived_product (assert the only writes are the two SELECT v3_meta.publish_derived_product calls and SET LOCAL). tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py: identity first; lock acquired before the first image check and released after; exit codes distinct; the attestation fields required; the probe pairs' exact URLs/bodies; the workflow routes publish-finder-products through the authority gate and the approval-gated job under v3-production-application-authority, stages with the production credential boundary, reads the attestation from target-authority.json, and never references ED_NEW_OPERATOR_ secrets.

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: bash -n on the action; ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py tests/test_python314_execution_surfaces.py -q -p no:warnings; both identity helpers' compute output (equal).
